semantic_anchor.outer_validation_scores: reuse frozen Stage 1 A2 ensemble_validation.parquet only
semantic_anchor.training_score_rule: within each outer fit source, generate semantic scores by 2-fold stratified cross-fitting; fit all three frozen A2 seeds per inner fold using unchanged RB-G1 hyperparameters; no row is scored by a semantic model trained on that row

feature_policy: Only numeric shape/count derivatives are allowed. Raw sender, receiver, domain strings, URL strings, source ID, language ID, and raw text are prohibited as residual-probe features.

probe.standardization: StandardScaler fit on probe-fit subset only
probe.coefficient_selection: fixed stratified 80/20 split of outer fit source; choose lowest log-loss on selection subset, ties choose smaller coefficient
probe.final_probe_rule: refit scaler and ridge on all cross-fitted rows from outer fit source using selected coefficient

evaluation.candidate_useful_rule: positive delta AUPRC and negative delta log-loss in both outer source-held-out folds, with no FPR increase > 0.002 at the frozen RB-G1 A2 threshold on either source
evaluation.kill_rule: kill a block if direction is inconsistent across outer sources, if log-loss worsens on either source, or if FPR harm exceeds 0.002 on either source

hard_prohibitions: No HPO beyond the frozen coefficient grid
No CGCF-KAN or graph model training
No confirmatory claim from RB-G2 development outcomes
